page_data.en:
. 10

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG             2nd February       1916
No. 32
Date 2 - 2

Sir,
    The workmen at the Arsenal have been granted three
days holiday.
    It is reported that General Yang has heard privately
that the Central Government intends to transfer him to
Fokien when the new year holidays have passed. It
is said that General Yang is very displeased with this news.
    It is reported that the police and military patrols
in the City will be doubled to-night and during the
next few days.
    It is reported that the civil Governor of Kiangsu
has recommended Magistrate Shen Yuen Zah 沈恩石 of
the City yamen for the post of Taoyin of Yangchow.
    Acting on instructions from Peking the police
have ordered the residents of the City to display the new
monarchical flags during the new year holidays. The
residents are greatly perturbed because of this order
as they do not even know what the monarchical flags are
like. It is said that the Nantao Chamber of Commerce
has taken up the matter with General Yang.
    The Shanghai Tramway Co is thinking about starting
a motor delivery service in Shanghai. The Company's
servants are now collecting information with a view
to estimating whether the venture would be likely to
prove profitable or otherwise.

                        Your Obedient Servant,

                        (签名)

                        Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

(手写批注：Seen by C.I.P.
Information filed.)
page_data.zh:
. 10

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海工部局。

中央侦探署
情报官登记册             1916年2月2日
第32号
日期 2 - 2

先生：
    兵工厂的工人已获准放假三天。
    据报，杨将军私下获悉，中央政府打算在新年假期过后将其调往福建。据说杨将军对此消息甚为不满。
    据报，华界今晚及未来数日的警力和军事巡逻将加倍。
    据报，江苏省民政长官已推荐上海县衙门知事沈恩石出任扬州道尹一职。
    警方奉北京方面指令，已命令华界居民在新年假期期间悬挂新的君主制旗帜。居民们因这项命令而深感不安，因为他们甚至不知道君主制旗帜是何模样。据说南市商会已就此事与杨将军进行交涉。
    上海电车公司正考虑在上海开办汽车送货服务。该公司职员目前正在收集信息，以评估该举措是否可能盈利。

                        您忠实的仆人，

                        (签名)

                        总探长。

警察总监。

(手写批注：警察总监已阅。
资料归档。)
